$comment: The art this site shows, copied byte for byte from Colorado-Startups/brand at the commit below. The brand repo owns the art: its direction, render queue, call counter and licences (art/LICENSES.md). Every file is AI-made and carries its provenance XMP; scripts/art.mjs refuses a file whose hash differs from this list and keeps that XMP in every variant it makes. No copyright is claimed in the images (brand decision 5). Each painting names the photo it was made from (brand art/render/src/SOURCES.md); a CC BY photo's credit shows wherever the painting does.
label: AI-made

images.alt: Painting of Boulder's Flatirons as a city of light at dusk: glowing portals set in the red rock slabs, waterfalls, a great golden tree on the ridge, robed elves on stone bridges, and dragons in the starry sky.
images.caption: Boulder, the research anchor, painted as a city of light.
images.model: FIBO 2.0 (Bria), an edit of a public-domain photo by Jimbo Herndan
images.landmark: The Flatirons, tilted slabs of red sandstone above the town

images.alt: Painting of Golden's Table Mountain as a dwarven kingdom: a great stone gate with glowing windows cut into the cliff, armored dwarves with carts and steam engines on the road, and a stone serpent coiled in the grass by the creek.
images.caption: Golden, the forge of the corridor, painted as a mountain kingdom.
images.model: FIBO 2.0 (Bria), an edit of a CC BY photo of the Table Mountains
images.landmark: North and South Table Mountain, with Clear Creek

images.alt: Painting of Denver's skyline and the Front Range behind a white-walled citadel with a golden great hall, knights on glowing white horses, townsfolk on the hill, white gryphons in the sky, and golden aspens.
images.caption: Denver, the metro anchor, painted as a citadel of the plain.
images.model: FIBO 2.0 (Bria), an edit of a public-domain USFWS photo
images.landmark: The downtown skyline below the Front Range

images.alt: The Photon Mountain crest: a white and gold dragon of light on a violet shield, in a gold rim with golden wings.
images.caption: The light dragon, Photon Mountain's crest.
images.model: FIBO 2.0 (Bria), an edit of the Colorado Startups emblem

clips.alt: Looping video of the Boulder painting: the portals in the rock glow and pulse, and motes of light drift up from the lanterns.
clips.caption: Light from Boulder, looped.
clips.model: LTX-2.5 image-to-video of the Boulder painting
